_comment: Community builds used in place of (or inside) the procedural landmarks.
Nothing here is used until you download the file into community/ and set approved=true after checking it against the show (layout, silhouette, colours).
Formats: .schem (Sponge v1-3), .litematic, .nbt (structure), or a world save: {"world": "community/x.zip", "min": [x,y,z], "max": [x,y,z]}.
Legacy .schematic (pre-1.13) must be converted first: WorldEdit on 1.13+ '//schem load name' then '//schem save name sponge.3'.
mode 'replace' = the build is the whole landmark; mode 'core' = keep the procedural surroundings and drop the build in at core_poi.
Placement keys: rotate (0-3 quarter turns clockwise), offset [dx,0,dz], y ('auto' or an absolute y), y_offset, base_y_local, pad (level the ground under it), blend, foundation, clear_margin.
candidates: builds found on Planet Minecraft (links, notes). They could not be downloaded or inspected from the build environment, so check each one yourself before approving.

fire_nation_capital.notes: Keeps the carved Royal Caldera, terraced city, Royal Plaza, Agni Kai arena and Harbor City; swaps in the palace. The caldera floor is ~300 blocks across - a palace wider than ~220 blocks will cut into the first terrace.
